description:
You probably already know…possibly the most handmade monē that ever monied.

Cranks…brazed. V custom. Based on Profile bmx spindle and bb.

Fork. Custom curved offset tri-plane with stainless truss. One of my fave custom forks we’ve done.

Finish…custom diamond brushed-turbo fade comeple with cute diamond accent errwhere. Very Schwinn. Very kewl.

Stem. 10 pinch bolts of mini moose glory. Ain't never gonna see another one.

Bar…custom spin on our oddmonē with custom curved crossbar and brass logo.

Knife! Silver City alligator juniper handle, Pakistani demascus, phil wood top cap (and headset). Handmade by me at monē.

Custom 29+ wheels with some real dirt track inspired 29×3.0 maxxis minions. It's a vibe. It's comfy. It also rips.

Jen green custom badge…one of my faves ever.

Brooks, Paul Post, Paul polish front hub. Our souped up coaster with every option.

This belonged to a customer a few years back.
